title: Monitoring Uptake and Youth-safety Risks of Emerging Social Apps
what_it_is: Monitoring Uptake and Youth-safety Risks of Emerging Social Apps

sections.label: IMDA sources of information
sections.summary: IMDA draws on public feedback, industry engagements, market data and developments in other jurisdictions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: To do so, IMDA draws on a range of sources, including public feedback, industry engagements, market data and developments in other jurisdictions.

sections.label: Broadcasting Act online safety directions
sections.summary: Under the Broadcasting Act, IMDA may direct social media services or app stores to disable Singapore users' access to egregious content.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Under the Broadcasting Act, IMDA may direct a social media service or app store to disable Singapore users' access to egregious content, such as content that advocates or instructs on suicide or self-harm.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: A social media service with significant reach or impact in Singapore may also be required to comply with the Code of Practice for Online Safety – Social Media Services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: IMDA considers various factors as laid out in the Broadcasting Act, including the extent and nature of the effect that the service has on people and communities in Singapore.

sections.label: App distribution services code
sections.summary: The Code of Practice for Online Safety for app distribution services requires age assurance measures to be put in place.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For one, we have the Code of Practice for Online Safety for the app distribution services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, there is already a gateway there, in that there are age assurance measures that already have to be put in place and this will effectively take away those who are below a certain age from exploring some of the applications which are not suitable for them.

sections.label: Screen Smart from The Start campaign
sections.summary: The national campaign "Screen Smart from The Start" provides parents with information and fundamental guidelines for children's digital habits.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In this, we have already worked on a national campaign, "Screen Smart from The Start", which is intended to provide parents with the information with fundamental guidelines, so that they can build healthy digital habits among their children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is something that is going to be continuing to be built on and evolved.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We already have IMDA's Digital for Life portal, which provides some of these resources.
